title: Kissed with chilli sauce Dutch mixture Wrap
description: Sweet, pillowy, light Dutch dish featuring chilli sauce and candy, wrapped in a corn-husk vessel for an anti-inflammatory snack. This unique dish is perfect for a quick pick-me-up.

ingredients.name: Chilli sauce
ingredients.notes: Look for a chilli sauce with no added sugars or artificial preservatives.

ingredients.name: Candy (e.g. Swedish fish)
ingredients.notes: Choose a candy that is low in refined sugar and high in fiber.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a full-fat coconut milk for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger paste
ingredients.notes: Look for a ginger paste that is free from added sugars or preservatives.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: Choose a raw, unfiltered honey for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a freshly squeezed lemon juice for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Turmeric powder
ingredients.notes: Look for a turmeric powder that is free from additives or fillers.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon powder
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cinnamon powder for the best flavor.

instructions: Soak the corn husk wrap in water for at least 30 minutes to make it pliable.
In a small bowl, mix together the chilli sauce, ginger paste, honey, and lemon juice until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix together the coconut milk, turmeric powder, and cinnamon powder until well combined.
Warm the corn husk wrap in a dry skillet or in the microwave for a few seconds to make it more pliable.
Place a small amount of the coconut milk mixture onto the center of the corn husk wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add a few pieces of the candy on top of the coconut milk mixture.
Drizzle the chilli sauce mixture on top of the candy.
Fold the bottom half of the corn husk wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
